description: This Kotlin source file defines the `DeviceHandler` class, which provides methods to gather and report various device-specific information such as battery status, device info, permissions, health metrics, and network status within an Android application. It interacts with Android system services and permissions to construct JSON payloads representing device state.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for collecting and providing device state information as JSON payloads in an Android environment.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Internal data class representing a snapshot of battery parameters such as status, plugged state, level fraction, and temperature in Celsius.

methods.name: hasAnySmsCapability
methods.description: Determines if the device has SMS capabilities based on multiple permission and feature checks.

methods.name: isSmsPromptable
methods.description: Checks if the device can prompt for SMS permissions based on current capabilities and permissions.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve the overall device status payload.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve basic device information such as model, system version, locale, etc.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve the current permissions status for various features.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Handles a request to gather device health metrics including memory, battery, and system status.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the device's battery, thermal, storage, and network statuses.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with device identification information such as model, manufacturer, system version, and locale.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON string summarizing permission statuses for various device features like camera, microphone, location, SMS, notifications, and contacts.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with device health metrics including memory usage, battery state, charging type, temperature, power modes, and system patch level.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves current battery information and constructs a BatterySnapshot object.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates battery level as a fraction from battery intent data.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status codes to human-readable states.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Maps charging plugged states to strings like 'ac', 'usb', etc.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Maps thermal status codes to descriptive strings such as 'nominal', 'fair', etc.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Converts network capabilities to a network status string.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Builds JSON object representing permission grant and promptability status.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission is granted.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available memory, and low memory flag.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON array listing the active network interfaces.
